source_row.rationale: GOLD uses post-bronchodilator FEV1 percent predicted to grade the severity of airflow obstruction after COPD is established. A lower FEV1 percent predicted corresponds to a more severe airflow-obstruction grade, but overall COPD assessment also incorporates symptoms, exacerbation history, and other clinical factors.
